item.title: Gilead dips as ‘strong’ earnings outweighed by high expectations for new HIV drug
item.description: Shares fell as much as 6% in after-hours trading, a decline one analyst guessed may be because Yeztugo’s trajectory isn’t matching investors’ sky-high hopes.

item.title: FDA refuses to review Moderna’s mRNA flu vaccine
item.description: Moderna claimed that the decision, issued by top vaccine regulator Vinay Prasad, was “inconsistent” with prior FDA communications and went against the regulator’s established guidance for flu shots.

item.title: Evommune rockets on eczema data; AstraZeneca advances GLP-1 pill
item.description: Shares of Evommune nearly doubled on data suggesting it has a potential threat to Dupixent. Elsewhere, a closely watched narcolepsy drug got an FDA decision date and investors scrutinized Upstream’s asthma results.

item.title: Madrigal turns to RNAi drugs from China to bolster MASH pipeline
item.description: The potentially $4.4 billion deal is Madrigal’s second with a China-based biotech and hands the company six preclinical RNA interference medicines for the common liver condition.

item.title: CDC moves to cut $600M in grants to Democrat-led states
item.description: The cut grants, which were viewed by Healthcare Dive, fund a wide swath of areas including workforce initiatives, STI prevention measures, health equity proposals, pediatric clinician training and others in California, Colorado, Illinois and Minnesota.

item.title: BridgeBio scores with dwarfism drug, setting up showdown with BioMarin, Ascendis
item.description: The latest in a string of clinical wins, the late-stage data gives the company strong footing to compete with BioMarin's top seller.

item.title: Sanofi, looking for more ‘rigor,’ swaps CEO Hudson for ex-Merck KGaA chief Garijo
item.description: The move drew skepticism from investors despite multiple recent research setbacks that have left questions about Sanofi’s ability to confront Dupixent’s looming patent expiration.

item.title: Lowering drug costs is on Republicans’ minds. Democrats say GOP policies don’t help.
item.description: At a House subcommittee hearing on Wednesday, lawmakers on both sides of the aisle decried the nation’s high drug costs, but Democrats argued Medicaid cuts and lapsed Affordable Care Act subsidies are worsening the problem.

item.title: Seres to lay off staff, pause top program in latest reboot
item.description: The microbiome specialist, which for years has struggled to stay afloat, is cutting its staff by 30% and focusing resources on earlier, immunology-focused research.

item.title: Earnings roundup: Neurocrine slumps, Alnylam battles skeptics and Ascendis eyes a competitor
item.description: Neurocrine and Alnylam each face investor questions about the growth potential of key franchises. Ascendis, meanwhile, saw an upbeat sales report overshadowed by the progress of an emerging rival.
